scope: Proposition 3.5 (Classical near-optimality in synthesis form) of the manuscript “QAOA attains the SK ground-state energy in the thermodynamic-first limit” (preprints/QAOA-attains-the-SK-ground-state-energy-in-the-thermodynamic-first-limit-September-25-2026/QAOA-attains-the-SK-ground-state-energy-in-the-thermodynamic-first-limit-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 281 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d07ebe181b03157), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every ε > 0 and every ηH > 0, there are a finite color partition with helper probability 0 < pH < ηH, a finite number of helper types, and finite bounded odd angle formulas θc on the nonhelper colors such that the following hold. Each transmitted column is bounded and odd, every pointwise map may be chosen as a finite trigonometric sum in its odd inputs, and every aggregation excludes its current color, all path-ancestor colors, and all helpers. Conditional on the finite labels, all continuous derivatives of the pointwise maps are bounded. The output mcol = M X c=1 1{C=c} sin(2θc) (3.14) is centered, satisfies |mcol| ≤ 1, vanishes on helper roots, and obeys E(mcol ) ≥ P∗ − ε. (3.15) After the uncolored finite formula has been fixed, the total helper probability may be taken arbitrarily small, with all individual helper probabilities positive. All depths, coefficients, label laws, and functions in the conclusion are fixed independently of degree, system size, and disorder.
